GoalOptions.Label: Accelerate Onboarding
GoalOptions.Text: Enable new engineers to quickly understand the AI-Powered Change Risk Assessment system's architecture, data flow, and core components. Success means a significant reduction in the time required for new team members to contribute effectively to the data pipeline and risk engine development.

GoalOptions.Label: Standardize Development
GoalOptions.Text: Establish clear guidelines and best practices for developing, testing, and deploying features within the Change Data Ingestion service and AI Risk Assessment Engine. This goal aims to ensure consistency, reduce technical debt, and improve the maintainability of the data pipeline.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance System Reliability
GoalOptions.Text: Provide developers with the knowledge and tools to identify potential failure points and implement robust solutions within the data pipeline. The ultimate success is measured by a measurable decrease in incidents related to change risk assessment inaccuracies or data ingestion failures.

GoalOptions.Label: Facilitate Troubleshooting
GoalOptions.Text: Equip developers with comprehensive information on common issues, diagnostic procedures, and resolution strategies for the AI-Powered Change Risk Assessment system. Success means faster incident resolution times and increased developer autonomy in debugging data pipeline anomalies.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Proficiency & Efficiency
Criteria: New engineers can independently deploy a minor feature to the Change Data Ingestion service within two weeks of reading the handbook.
Developers can accurately describe the end-to-end data flow from change request ingestion to risk assessment output.
The handbook reduces the average time spent by senior developers answering basic system architecture questions by 25%.
Existing developers can troubleshoot and resolve 80% of common data pipeline errors using only the handbook as a reference.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Stability & Compliance
Criteria: The handbook's guidelines lead to a 15% reduction in production incidents related to change risk assessment inaccuracies within six months.
All new data pipeline components developed adhere to documented security and data privacy standards outlined in the handbook.
Developers can articulate how the system's data processing aligns with relevant risk management and regulatory compliance requirements.
The handbook facilitates a consistent understanding of error handling and logging standards across all microservices in the data pipeline.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Developer Experience & Contribution
Criteria: 85% of developers rate the handbook as 'very helpful' or 'extremely helpful' for understanding the AI risk assessment system.
The handbook inspires at least 10 pull requests for documentation improvements or new content within the first quarter of its release.
New contributors report feeling confident in making their first code change to the data pipeline after consulting the handbook.
The handbook clearly defines contribution guidelines, leading to a 20% increase in external (non-core team) contributions to the system.
